title: Seven-Day Covenant
next_chapter_hook: When Chen Ji decided to temporarily suppress his fury, he sensed the dormant consciousness deep within the Tianji Record seemed to quiver slightly—the Heavenly Eye had already noticed his hatred.

text.content: The night wind carried the unique sweet and fishy scent of the Demonic Path, lingering long after her departure. Chen Ji stood in place, gripping the warm communication jade talisman, his knuckles white. Her words 'Beware the Holy Sect' still echoed in his ears, but the following words struck like a basin of ice water poured over his head—'What they did to your sister is more terrible than you can imagine.' Chen Nian, the sister who had been missing for years, the figure whose face remained blurred in the Tianji Record's visions, actually had such deep connections to the Holy Sect. He took a deep breath, suppressed the surging emotions, sat cross-legged beneath the ancient pine, and delved his consciousness into the Tianji Record Fragment.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng's remnant soul spoke in a hollow voice) Young Master, you finally asked about that Seven-Day Covenant. This old one has waited for this day far too long.

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak, his consciousness traveling through the chaos. The golden runes on the fragment flowed like water, gradually sketching out a clear image—a blood-red sky, a massive vertical pupil suspended above the nine heavens, and within its depths, countless intertwined threads of fate were reflected. And in the very center of the pupil, a woman in black silk was slowly kneeling—that figure was unmistakably Ye Qing. Before her, a covenant rune was taking shape.

dialogue.content: (A transcendent, genderless ancient voice emerged from the vertical pupil) The position of Holy Sect's Saint of the Demonic Path, I can grant you. But you must pay with information about the Tianji Record's bearer—his whereabouts, his abilities, and those around him, all fall within the covenant.

text.content: Chen Ji's pupils contracted sharply. The Tianji Record's vision flooded in like a tide, revealing more—the covenant emanated a strange purple-black glow, containing fragments of the Law of Fate. Once the covenant was signed, within seven days, everything Ye Qing perceived would resonate with the Tianji Record. Every trace of Chen Ji using the Tianji Record, every vision he foresaw, would leave an imprint like a candle flame in Ye Qing's soul. The Holy Sect, through her, had completed their surveillance of the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: (Ye Qing's voice trembled in the vision, yet carried resolve) I agree. But after the covenant period ends, you must set me free, and never threaten me with this again.

text.content: A hint of a smile seemed to flash in that vertical pupil, yet it was more chilling than any coldness. The moment the covenant formed, countless threads of fate extended from Ye Qing like a spider's web, weaving in all directions. Chen Ji saw that the ends of those threads were precisely connected toward the Tianqing Sect—toward him. The Seven-Day Covenant, from the very beginning, had him on that chessboard, watched by countless people as he walked step by step toward his predetermined fate.

Chen Ji abruptly opened his eyes, spitting out a mouthful of blood. His Heavenly Fate Value was depleting madly, and fury like a venomous snake gnawed at his sanity. He remembered now—that seven days corresponded exactly to the period when he first used the Tianji Record. Every vision, every scheme, was being broadcast live to that high and mighty Heavenly Eye. He thought he was playing chess, yet he did not know he was the most pitiful piece on that board.

dialogue.content: (Mo Xiansheng sighed and said) Young Master, do not underestimate this Seven-Day Covenant. It is not merely surveillance, but a curse—anything the Tianji Record perceives during the covenant period, Ye Qing can share; and the covenanter can conversely influence the Tianji Record bearer's judgment. The Holy Sect's Saint has remained safely at the position of the number one expert in the Demonic Path until now—Young Master, do you think she achieved this by what?

text.content: Chen Ji slowly stood up, the blood at the corner of his mouth stark and shocking under the moonlight. His eyes no longer held their former calm, replaced by an abyss-like cold. Ye Qing, the Holy Sect, the Heavenly Eye—everyone played a role in his chess game, everyone knew secrets he did not. And his sister Chen Nian, missing for years, was now being used by these forces as a 'Destiny Key,' perhaps suffering in some dark corner beyond his imagination.

dialogue.content: (He murmured to himself, his voice cold as January ice) A fine Seven-Day Covenant. A fine Heavenly Eye. Let me see, when you lofty chess players are bitten back by your pieces, what expressions you will make.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji took a deep breath, forcing himself to calm down. Fury solves nothing, but the debt accrued will someday be settled. How should he face this brutal truth?

choices.description: Ye Qing must explain all this face to face. He needed to know whether she was a co-conspirator or coerced, and the whereabouts of his sister Chen Nian.
choices.visible_reward: Obtain complete intelligence and establish a foundation of trust
choices.risk_hint: Ye Qing may completely collapse from guilt

text.content: Chen Ji crushed the jade talisman, sending a sharp spiritual transmission through the night: 'Ye Qing, come to the ancient pine immediately. I know about the Seven-Day Covenant.' Moments later, a black figure broke through the air. When Ye Qing landed, tears still wet on her face. Seeing the blood at the corner of Chen Ji's mouth, the guilt in her eyes nearly overflowed.

choices.description: Revealing everything now would only alert the enemy. Better to turn the tables and use Ye Qing's connection with the Heavenly Eye to gather intelligence in reverse.
choices.visible_reward: Gain a reverse intelligence channel and master the initiative
choices.risk_hint: If detected by Ye Qing, may trigger a greater crisis

text.content: Chen Ji put the jade talisman into his sleeve, his expression restored to its usual calm. He took out the Tianji Record Fragment and sketched a hidden tracking rune on the blank space—if Ye Qing could sense the Tianji Record's fluctuations, then he would do unto others as they did unto him. When the rune formed, a faint, undetectable connection came from the direction where Ye Qing was. A cold smile curved his lips.

However, just as Chen Ji was contemplating, a strange fluctuation suddenly came from deep within the Tianji Record. That consciousness dormant in the deepest part of the fragment had actually opened its eyes at this moment. An indescribable pressure pressed in from all directions, as if countless eyes were watching him from the void. Chen Ji's heart chilled—the Heavenly Eye had sensed his hatred.

dialogue.content: (A transcendent, beyond-the-senses thought exploded like thunder) Interesting... The lamb being raised has finally learned to be angry? But do you know, fury itself is also one of the chess moves I have laid?

text.content: Chen Ji's entire body stiffened for an instant, then he threw his head back and laughed wildly. That laughter carried madness, carried unwillingness, and even more carried a desperate resolve. He had never imagined the day would come when he would face the so-called Heavenly Dao head-on. But at this moment, all his fear transformed into a surging hatred. He, Chen Ji, from this day forward, would be the one who plays the game—even if the opponent was the Heavenly Dao, was Fate, was the most invincible existence across all realms.

choice.prompt: The Heavenly Eye's mockery rang in his ears. How should Chen Ji respond to this existence that transcended everything?

choices.description: Since the Heavenly Dao viewed him as a chess piece, he would use the words of a piece to counter-deride the Heavenly Dao, letting that lofty being know he, Chen Ji, was not someone to be manipulated at will.
choices.visible_reward: Issue a declaration of war before the Heavenly Dao and seize psychological initiative
choices.risk_hint: The power of the Heavenly Eye is fathomless

dialogue.content: (Chen Ji said coldly) Heavenly Dao? Hmph, a coward hiding beyond the heavens manipulating the chessboard. If you truly have ability, why not step onto the field yourself? Making a mortal your chess piece—this Heavenly Dao is nothing more than this!

choices.description: Confronting the Heavenly Dao head-on was no different from dashing an egg against a rock. He chose silence, pressing all fury deep in his heart, secretly gathering strength, awaiting the day to break the game.
choices.visible_cost: Endure the Heavenly Dao's might and endure inner torment
choices.visible_reward: Avoid the Heavenly Dao's lock and buy time for growth

text.content: Chen Ji did not speak a word, only slowly closing his eyes, letting that might wash over his soul like a tide. The Heavenly Eye's thought echoed in the darkness for a moment, seemingly bored by his silence, then slowly retreated. But Chen Ji knew this was merely the calm before the storm—the Heavenly Eye had already noticed him, and his time might be even less than he imagined.

Deep within the Tianji Record, that consciousness fell into silence once more. But Chen Ji clearly sensed that beneath that silence, something was quietly changing. The Heavenly Eye was no longer a high-and-mighty bystander; it had begun to regard him as a chess piece worthy of attention. This was both danger and opportunity. He took from his sleeve a jade pendant he had always kept close to his body—it was a gift from his sister Chen Nian when she was young, still carrying her aura.

dialogue.content: (He said softly, his voice carrying rare tenderness) Nian-Nian, wait for brother. No matter where they have hidden you, no matter what price I must pay, I will find you. Those who used you as a chess piece—I will make them understand what price must be paid for touching someone Chen Ji cares about.

text.content: The night wind blew once more, carrying faint beast roars from the distant mountains. Chen Ji carefully stored the jade pendant, his gaze fixed toward the southeast—that was where the Holy Sect's main altar lay, also the most likely place his sister was imprisoned. He knew that with his current strength, rushing in would be no different from seeking death. But he had the Tianji Record, had Mo Xiansheng's guidance, and more importantly, he had a heart that refused to be a chess piece and was determined to overturn the board.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji rose and prepared to leave the ancient pine. His next actions would determine the trajectory of his relationships with these forces.

choices.description: Although Ye Qing was a victim of the covenant, she was also the only person who understood the internal situation of the Holy Sect. Instead of seeking accountability, better to seek cooperation and jointly oppose the Heavenly Eye.
choices.visible_reward: Gain intelligence from the Holy Sect's interior and a potential ally
choices.risk_hint: Whether Ye Qing is willing to take the risk remains uncertain

dialogue.content: (He activated the jade talisman again, his voice much calmer) Ye Qing, I lost control just now. We are both chess pieces, so why make things difficult for each other? Regarding the Seven-Day Covenant, I can let bygones be bygones, but you must答应我一件事——帮我找到我妹妹陈念。

choices.description: Since Ye Qing was bound by the covenant with the Heavenly Eye, she could leak intelligence again at any time. He decided to act alone, using the Tianji Record's abilities to secretly investigate the Holy Sect.
choices.risk_hint: The Holy Sect is heavily guarded; solo infiltration is extremely dangerous

text.content: Chen Ji put away the jade talisman and vanished into the night. He did not return to the Tianqing Sect but instead rushed in the opposite direction—where an ancient ruin from the primordial era lay, said to have been a gathering place for prophets, perhaps holding secrets about the Destiny Key. The night wind howled, his eyes burned with vengeful fire, yet he was more composed than ever.

Shortly after Chen Ji departed, a black silk figure quietly landed atop the ancient pine. Ye Qing gazed at the direction where he vanished, complex emotions flickering in her eyes. She gently touched the faintly visible covenant mark above her collarbone, a bitter smile curving her lips. The covenant had ended, but that mark could never be erased—it reminded her of the person she had once betrayed, now walking a path utterly different from her own.

Ye Qing murmured softly: 'Chen Ji, do you think I signed that covenant because I was greedy for the Saint's position?' Her voice scattered in the night wind, unanswered. She drew from her sleeve a shattered communication jade talisman, which she had stolen from the Holy Sect, containing fragments of information about the 'Destiny Key.' She gently cast away the jade talisman, letting it fall into the abyss below. 'Some truths, you will eventually know. By then, perhaps you will forgive me, perhaps you will kill me. But no matter what, I owe you, and I must repay it.'

Chen Ji knew nothing of what happened behind him. At this moment, he had arrived before an abandoned ancient temple, the words 'Heavenly Secrets' barely visible on its gate. Pushing the door open, a desolate aura rushed to meet him. The walls were covered with dense, intricate ancient runes, each one containing the mysteries of fate. He slowly extended his hand, and the moment his fingertips touched those runes, a sensation like an electric current shot through his mind—he saw a blurred image: a blood-colored cage, a girl with features similar to his own trapped among countless chains, and the source of those chains was actually connected to the Tianji Record itself.
